verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Lease lifecycle and safety semantics: all six lifecycle states, renewal-dependent fixed leases, reclamation, never-repool destruction, maximum age, and non-disruptive image retirement are explicitly represented with labeled states, notes, and directed paths.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: No stated requirement is absent, partial, or contradicted.
verdict.coverage_summary: All 41 atomic requirements are fully and consistently represented in the rendered board. Placement behavior, lifecycle and destruction semantics, per-call controls, durable-output handling, warm-pool supervision, quarantine, quotas, and operational monitoring are all present. Weighted coverage is complete and no cap applies.
